The lock must be checked immediately after the permission check, not after existing domain guards like archived status. This means it belongs right after assertCan and before any same-status early returns.

The lock check must precede all subsequent business rules, including archived status and quota. A locked workspace will return a lock error instead of an already-archived error for an archived issue. Canceled subscriptions lock immediately if cancelAt is null. Otherwise they remain writable until that date. Active subscriptions stay writable even with a cancelAt set.
